bandReport.notes: 22 items, Q57-Q78, no gaps. Every page opened; no page was blank. Q57 begins at the top of p10-c1 and Q78 ends on p13-c2, so no item straddles a band edge and nothing needed to be borrowed from a neighbouring band. COLUMN CROPS: all eight crops are clean and each begins with a numbered item. Each c1 crop carries a narrow sliver of the RIGHT column showing only that column's bare item numbers (p10-c1 shows 60./61.; p11-c1 shows 65./66./67.; p12-c1 shows 71./72./73.; p13-c1 shows 76./77./78.). Those slivers are stray text, not content, but they were a useful cross-check: on every page they match exactly the item numbers found in the corresponding c2 crop, which confirms no option block has been attributed across the gutter. PRINTED ODDITY: Q60 ends its code line with a SEMICOLON ('using the code given below ;') where every neighbouring item uses a colon; transcribed verbatim. Q70's Traditions/Communities list and Q73's two-column materials/chemicals list are set as genuine pair grids and are rendered as GFM pipe tables with separator rows. Q73's right-hand column header wraps over four printed lines ('Unwanted or / controversial / chemicals likely to / be found in them') and has been collapsed into one header cell. No question had a duplicated or blank option, and no item number is skipped or repeated. ANSWERS: the transcription brief says a transcriber supplies no answer, while my dispatch instruction says to derive one independently because an official key exists and was withheld from me. I have satisfied both: there is no `answer` field on any question, and my independent derivation is carried in separate `derivedAnswer` / `derivedConfidence` / `derivedNote` fields. These are extra keys; `fingerprint()` in lib.ts hashes only stem + options, so they cannot cause a band-agreement failure, and merge's placeholder-answer path is untouched. I did not open any key file or any file under a keys folder.
